svg.aria-label: th3-skills: The front door to the whole toolkit. One command routes your task to the skill that owns it. Steps: Read, what the task actually is; Route, plans, design, qa, devops…; Default, plans runs the build pipeline; Hand off, the right skill takes it. Output: the right skill, picked for you, plans by default to build.
